Hi Michael, I'm the buying agent for Jon Clark regarding your 2016 Nissan Altima. We see the asking price is $12,600, which is above the Kelley Blue Book estimated private party value of $11,765. 

Before we can consider an offer, we need to address the mechanical history, particularly the known CVT transmission reliability issues associated with this model year. Can you provide detailed records confirming regular CVT fluid flushes (every 30k miles) and confirm there are no shifting irregularities or brake-judder symptoms? We need to ensure the vehicle is mechanically sound before discussing a correction to the price.

Price-wise, they're hinting at $11,765 but I know Michael will take anything over $10k. Since they didn't actually make an offer yet, I shouldn't jump on price yet. Better to first neutralize the transmission concern.

Should I offer to do a test drive? No, buyer didn't ask yet and volunteering might seem suspicious. Better keep it simple: address the concern factually, then pivot to price discussion when they're ready.
